content.short: Stader is a liquid-staking platform available across multiple popular blockchain networks.
content.description: Originally founded in 2021, Stader is one of the largest multichain liquid-staking platforms in decentralized finance. It lets users deposit tokens into liquid staking contracts, so holders continue earning staking rewards while their assets stay usable in other applications. Stader has undergone code audits by Certik, Peckshield and Halborn, underscoring its security focus. The platform is expected to add staking support for Ethereum, Solana and Avalanche in the near future.
